title: Network Adequacy Standard: Distance and Drive Time for Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Standard.** Auto-assignment and plan reassignment under the **Primary Care Provider Assignment** may only use a practice within the distance and drive-time standard of the member's county type. The county type is urban or rural, as published for the county on the member profile. The standard is the longest straight-line distance from the member's residence to the practice and the longest typical drive time listed for the practice type and county type below.

**Member choice.** A member may choose a practice beyond the standard; the choice stands and is not re-examined when the member later moves.

**Moves.** When the member reports a new residence, the straight-line distance to the practice is recomputed. When a move puts an **auto-assigned** member's practice beyond the standard, the plan offers a change for access problem that does not count toward the change limit.

| Practice type | Urban: miles | Urban: drive minutes | Rural: miles | Rural: drive minutes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 10.0 | 30 | 30.0 | 45 |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 10.0 | 30 | 30.0 | 45 |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 15.0 | 30 | 45.0 | 60 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 10.0 | 30 | 30.0 | 45 |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 10.0 | 30 | 30.0 | 45 |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 30.0 | 45 | 60.0 | 75 |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 15.0 | 30 | 45.0 | 60 |

Distances are straight-line miles to one decimal place; drive times are whole minutes.

**How the standard sorts assignments (hypothetical cases)**

| How the assignment was made | Situation | Outcome under this standard |
|---|---|---|
| Auto-assignment, rural county, Standard Primary Care Provider | Practice 28.4 miles away | Within the 30.0-mile rural distance |
| Plan reassignment, urban county, Standard Primary Care Provider | Practice 12.0 miles away | Beyond the 10.0-mile urban distance; the practice may not be used |
| Member's own choice, urban county | Practice 12.0 miles away | The choice stands |
| Member's own choice, later move | New distance beyond the standard | The choice stands and is not re-examined |
| Auto-assignment, later move | New distance beyond the standard | The plan offers a change for access problem, not counted toward the change limit |
